segments.en: It is very good to pray and to express one’s words (-sentiments) before Hashem Yisburach in a field in the grasses and the trees. Because when a person prays and expresses his words in a field, then all the grasses and all the vegetation of the field, all of them come into his prayer and help him and give him power in his prayer and conversing.
(Likutay Moharan II, Torah 11; Outpouring of the Soul 27-8)
